evidence_quote: Password Manager manages rotation guaranteeing passwords cannot be stolen
notes: AES-256 encrypted vault; automatic rotation of privileged/shared credentials, service accounts, and SSH keys. Open architecture supports integration with external vaults.

evidence_quote: Session isolation restricts access and prevents lateral movement
notes: Bastion proxy architecture prevents all direct access to targets; firewall rules enforce all sessions through Session Manager. Supports RDP, SSH, VNC, RLOGIN, TELNET.

evidence_quote: Audit trail includes full-color video transcript and metadata
notes: DVR-like video recordings with OCR-indexed searchable content; MP4 export; live session monitoring; unalterable audit logs. Considered WALLIX core differentiator.

evidence_quote: Eliminate excessive privileges and enact Zero Standing Privileges policy
notes: PEDM delivers JIT elevation via PAM4ALL; temporary elevation granted per-task and auto-revoked. ZSP reduces always-on accounts to time-limited grants.

evidence_quote: Discovery module maps network to unveil hidden privileged accounts
notes: Network-scan Discovery module identifies forgotten/orphaned privileged accounts. Scope limited to on-prem/AD targets; cloud-native discovery depth is moderate.

evidence_quote: Secured mechanism to authenticate application with another — no exposed passwords
notes: AAPM eliminates hard-coded credentials in scripts/config files via fingerprinting technology for app identity. Removes password exposure from DevOps pipelines.

evidence_quote: Seamless integration and maintenance for uncompromised security with PAM
notes: WALLIX Authenticator (iOS/Android/desktop) supports push notification and TOTP; native integration with Bastion and Access Manager for privileged session MFA.

evidence_quote: High availability between different data-centres breaking glass procedure
notes: Break-glass documented alongside HA and DR in WALLIX One PAM deployment guide. Approver-based emergency workflow exists in Users & Approvers Guide. Not prominently marketed as standalone feature.

evidence_quote: BestSafe eliminates risks of overprivileged users preventing malware spread
notes: WALLIX BestSafe (EPM) enforces least privilege at process/application level on Windows; removes local admin rights without productivity impact. Packaged as WALLIX EPM within PAM4ALL.

evidence_quote: PEDM removes local administration rights to grant right privileges at right time
notes: PEDM + BestSafe enforce entitlement right-sizing at endpoint and server level; PAM4ALL extends to all user types. IAG module adds access-review remediation path.

evidence_quote: No VPN no shared passwords maximum security for third-party access
notes: WALLIX Remote Access / Access Manager provides agentless, VPN-free privileged vendor access; MFA enforced; sessions recorded; vendors not added to corporate AD. Named FI and OT use case.

evidence_quote: Enables PAM across multiple clouds edge and on-premises environments
notes: WALLIX Bastion deployable on AWS/Azure Marketplace; manages privileged cloud accounts within vault. No native CIEM (entitlement right-sizing across IAM roles/policies). Cloud-native entitlement analytics require partner SIEM/CSPM. [INDUSTRY-CONSENSUS: WALLIX is not a CIEM vendor]

evidence_quote: Use secure vaults such as Wallix Bastion for API keys and certificates
notes: WALLIX Bastion/Enterprise Vault stores NHI secrets with encryption and audit. AAPM covers app-to-app credential injection. True secretless workload attestation (SPIFFE/OIDC federation) not documented as native capability. [INDUSTRY-CONSENSUS: secretless workload identity is an emerging gap for WALLIX]

evidence_quote: Centralized view into employees and contractors entitlements with certification campaigns
notes: WALLIX IAG provides access certification/recertification campaigns covering privileged accounts; tracks orphan/dormant accounts; integrates ITSM remediation. Available as separate IAG module, not bundled in Bastion core.

evidence_quote: PAM integrates with SIEM IDS and SAO to identify and stop suspicious actions
notes: Session Manager feeds behavioral data and metadata to Splunk, IBM QRadar, and other SIEMs. Real-time alerts for policy violations. No native ML-based UEBA engine — analytics rely on SIEM partner integration.

evidence_quote: Real-time session monitoring and recording with metadata extraction enable audit trails
notes: Automated password rotation + session recording + instant alarm/termination detects credential misuse in-session. Credential theft detection is reactive (alert on anomalous use) not predictive. UEBA-level detection requires SIEM integration.

evidence_quote: High availability between different data-centres disaster recovery backups snapshots
notes: WALLIX One PAM SaaS: 99.9% uptime SLA on Azure, ISO 27001 certified, single-tenant isolated architecture. On-prem Bastion supports active-active and active-standby IPsec HA with BGP failover. DR and snapshot backups documented.
